g.text: 1. 🔍 PX (Plan Execute) - AI selects next task and creates implementation strategy
2. 👤 HUMAN APPROVAL CHECKPOINT - Human reviews PX plan and decides:
❌ "Needs revision" → back to PX for refinement
🔄 "Split task" → back to CP for task breakdown
3. ⚡ AX (Approve Execute) - AI implements ONLY after human approval
4. 👤 HUMAN REVIEW CHECKPOINT - Human reviews AX results:
🔄 "Needs changes" → provide feedback for next iteration
New Feature: START → PF → CP → PX → AX → (PX → AX)* → CF → END
Error Handling: PX → AX → XE → FX → PX → AX → CF
Resume Work: RESUME → RP → PX → AX → (PX → AX)* → CF
Core Loop: PX (select task) → AX (implement) → repeat until done
1. START → Enter the workflow with a new feature request
2. PF (Plan Features) → Define what needs to be built
3. CP (Create Plan) → Generate detailed plan.md file with task list
🔄 Core Execution Loop (Repeat for Each Task):
4. PX (Plan Execute) → Select next [ ] task from plan.md
6. AX (Approve Execute) → Implement the approved task
8. Update plan.md → Mark task [x] with ✅ timestamp
9. Decision Point → More tasks? Return to step 4. All done? Proceed to CF
10. CF (Complete Feature) → Finalize and document completion
• XE (Execution Error) → Identify what went wrong
• Return to PX → Re-plan and continue
• RESUME → Pick up where you left off
• Human approval required before ANY code execution (PX → AX transition) | • Tasks processed one at a time in sequence | • All progress tracked in plan.md | • Loop continues until all tasks complete
• Current: Task 1 - Setting up PostgreSQL auth tables
• Tech Stack: PostgreSQL, bcrypt, JWT, Express middleware

svg.text: How Tasks Flow Through the System

g.text: • Each task must be atomic - completable in one PX→AX cycle (15-30 min)
• Human approval is MANDATORY before any code execution
• plan.md is the single source of truth - persists across all sessions
• Failed tasks trigger XE→FX error handling flow, never abandoned
